subject: A practical idea for OpenAI
body:
Hi OpenAI team,

I looked at your company and noticed this: I looked up OpenAI. That usually means extra pressure around making repetitive business workflows more consistent and less manual around AI-assisted lead enrichment and outreach.

I help teams simplify that with AI-assisted lead enrichment and outreach — especially where quick response, cleaner handoffs, and better client-facing communication matter.

If useful, I can send a short tailored breakdown or a concrete example for OpenAI. Would a 10-minute intro next week be useful?

Best,
Mikhail
